source: product_registrations.registration_number (US)

label: BLA #
rule: Conditional: device BLA only
source: product_registrations.registration_number (US, BLA)

label: Combination Product
rule: Conditional: combination products
source: ask once per product: Combination product?

label: Type of report
rule: Mandatory on manufacturer follow-ups (FDA required); initial: check all that apply
source: derived: report_obligations.report_type (US_30_DAY / US_5_WORK_DAY) + report kind

label: Type of Report\Follow-up Number
rule: Conditional: required when G6 = Follow-up
source: derived: follow-up sequence on the initial report

label: MFR Report #
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: all manufacturer reports). Never together with F2.
source: derived: report number generator (CFN/FEI setting + year + sequence)

label: Type of reportable event
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: manufacturer initial reports)
source: derived: complaint_market_assessments.answers (US1-US5)

label: No. of events (NOE) summarized
rule: Conditional: summary (VMSR) reports only
source: derived: count of summarised events (VMSR)

label: Response to FDA Request
rule: Conditional: on a manufacturer follow-up tick at least one (MDARIX rule; 21 CFR 803.56 requires identifying the report as supplemental)
source: ask at step: What type of follow-up? (suggested from what changed)

label: Additional Information
rule: Conditional: on a manufacturer follow-up tick at least one (MDARIX rule; 21 CFR 803.56 requires identifying the report as supplemental)
source: ask at step: What type of follow-up? (suggested from what changed)

label: Device Evaluation
rule: Conditional: on a manufacturer follow-up tick at least one (MDARIX rule; 21 CFR 803.56 requires identifying the report as supplemental)
source: ask at step: What type of follow-up? (suggested from what changed)

label: Correction
rule: Conditional: on a manufacturer follow-up tick at least one (MDARIX rule; 21 CFR 803.56 requires identifying the report as supplemental)
source: ask at step: What type of follow-up? (suggested from what changed)

label: Device evaluated by mfr? YES/NO
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: derived: investigations (device evaluation step done) -> Yes/No, confirm at step

label: Device manufacture date
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: lot_batches.manufactured_on (new column), else ask at step: Device manufacture date

label: Labeled for single use?
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: products.single_use

label: Adverse Event Problem codes (refer to coding manual)
rule: (see code rows)

label: Health Effect - Clinical Code
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex E) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Health Effect - Impact Code
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex F) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Medical Device Problem Code
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex A) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Component Code
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex G) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Type of Investigation
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex B) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Investigation Findings
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex C) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: Investigation Conclusions
rule: Mandatory (FDA required: at least 1 code of every type on manufacturer initial reports)
source: imdrf_code_mappings of complaints.problem_code (Annex D) + reference_codes FDA_CDRH, confirmed per report

label: If remedial action initiated, check type
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: derived: capas.action_type mapped to FDA types, confirm at step

label: If remedial action initiated, check type\Explanation for Other
rule: Conditional: when H7 = Other
source: ask at step: Remedial action (other)

label: Usage of device
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: ask at step: Usage of device (Initial/Reuse/Unknown)

label: If action reported to FDA under 21 USC 360i(g), list correction/removal reporting number
rule: Conditional: when a correction/removal was reported (21 CFR 806)
source: ask at step: Correction/removal number (prefilled from a linked recall record)

label: Related Report Numbers
rule: Optional (conditional in practice: other MDRs for the same event)
source: derived: other MDARIX reports on the same complaint + UF/importer report numbers received

label: Additional manufacturer narrative
rule: Required if known (21 CFR 803.32 / 803.42 / 803.52); FDA does not reject a blank
source: derived: investigation summary (investigations), editable
